issues: 132px 灰白等宽字在浅灰底上，乱码与锁定字只是深浅差，没有终端感也没有光
锁定匀速 6f/字，从头到尾一个速度，节奏平
解码头只有一道细下划线，"扫描波前"读不出来；进度条和计数是 3px 细线 + 小字
画面只有一行字，上下大片空白，结尾帧不成画面
changes: look 换成 lime 荧光终端：石墨底 + 荧光黄绿，背景是虚化、缓慢上滚的十六进制转储 + CRT 扫描线，标题 176px 等宽粗体「ZERO LATENCY」占画宽 66%
解码波前做成可见的光：一束竖向荧光光柱 + 下划线光标扫过，离波前越近的乱码越亮、染荧光、改 1f/次跳动并带色差错位
节奏改「慢起—加速—急停」：锁定间隔按曲线 8.3f → 3.4f 越来越快，锁定瞬间荧光反色块 2f + 字形 1.16→1 + 衰减底光；标题锁完副标题 0.8f/字瀑布解码
补全终端版式：DECRYPTING 状态胶囊 → ✓ VERIFIED 翻转、文件名 / 算法眉题、48px 副标题（4 ms 高亮）、按字分段的 11 格进度轨 + 跳动的区块地址定格为 0xC0DE + 计数
时长 140f：14–72f 标题锁定、74–98f 副标题、100f 验证完成、之后 hold，整幅 1.00→1.02 极缓推近
issuesEn: 132px pale mono type on a light grey background; scrambled and locked characters differed only in shade, with no terminal feel and no light
Characters locked at a flat 6f each from start to finish, so the rhythm never changed
The decode head was a thin underline, so the scanning wavefront did not read; the progress bar and counter were a 3px line and small text
One line of text with empty space above and below; the end frame was not a composition
changesEn: Lime phosphor-terminal look: graphite and fluorescent yellow-green, over a defocused, slowly scrolling hex dump and CRT scanlines, with a 176px bold mono ZERO LATENCY spanning 66% of the frame
The decode wavefront is now visible light: a vertical phosphor beam and underline cursor sweep across, and glyphs near it brighten, take the accent, flicker every frame and split chromatically

Rhythm is slow start, speed-up, hard stop: lock intervals shrink from 8.3f to 3.4f; each lock gets a 2f phosphor inverse block, a 1.16→1 pop and a fading underglow; then the subtitle cascades at 0.8f per character

Full terminal layout: a DECRYPTING pill that flips to ✓ VERIFIED, file and cipher kicker, a 48px subtitle with 4 ms highlighted, an 11-segment per-character progress rail, a churning block address that freezes on 0xC0DE, and a counter
140f: title locks at 14–72f, subtitle at 74–98f, verified at 100f, then hold; the whole frame pushes in 1.00→1.02
